note: General Contractors are not currently required to have a state license in Oklahoma (verbatim from CIB's own FAQ, corroborated across 3 official oklahoma.gov/cib.html pages). The Construction Industries Board licenses only 6 specific trades (electrical, plumbing, mechanical/HVAC, roofing, building/home inspectors) via their own trade-specific acts -- no general-contractor chapter exists anywhere in Title 59. The existing Title 59 Ch. 11 Roofing Contractor Registration Act corpus is a legitimate CIB trade-act pull, not evidence of general-contractor licensing (2026-07-08, hand-verified).
